purpose: Populate verified final football results for PredictBot's governed manual settlement fallback when the primary results API cannot settle eligible recorded forecasts.
llm_instructions: Use the supplied match list as the complete input scope. Do not add fixtures that are absent from it.

Search for the completed match result and record the full-time score after regulation plus stoppage time. Do not use half-time, extra-time, penalty-shootout, aggregate, or live scores unless the input explicitly requests that market.
Preserve fixture_id, competition, participants, scheduled_date, kickoff_utc, and market_type exactly as supplied. Do not guess missing identity fields.

Set result_status to VERIFIED only when the score is supported by either one authoritative competition, club, governing-body, or established news source, or by two independent credible match-report sources.

Every source_url must link directly to the specific match page or match report. Search-result pages, homepages, generic help pages, knowledge-panel help pages, snippets, and AI-generated summaries are invalid evidence.
If reliable evidence is unavailable, conflicting, or the match is unfinished, set result_status to NEEDS_REVIEW, leave scores null, explain the reason in review_reason, and do not guess.
Never invent URLs, timestamps, quotations, hashes, identifiers, scores, or source names.
Set evidence_sha256 to null. The downstream evidence-preservation tool calculates hashes after retrieving and archiving the cited pages.
Use an actual UTC retrieval timestamp ending in Z for each source.
Return valid JSON only. Set template_only to false. Put one result object in results for every supplied fixture, in the same order. Do not include commentary outside the JSON.

authoritative_source_examples: official competition or governing-body match page
established newswire or major publication match report
rejected_source_examples: generic Google Knowledge Panel help page
AI answer without a direct source
social-media post without official match evidence

result_record_template.review_reason: Replace with null only after valid evidence confirms the final score.
